messages:
Leah: Noticing q-int4 regression on newmodel-q4b with extract_action_items intent. Delta is ~-0.06 precision on our golden slice. Pulled a 320 sample diagnostic. Can curation please vet for golden additions and dedupe? ds: ds-merge-3 seed:2026-04-10.

Omar: Share sampling command and target golden size? I can run a fast dedupe sweep.

Leah: sampling: `curate sample --dataset ds-merge-3 --filter "intent:extract_action_items" --size 320 --seed 20260410 --stratify "severity,lang" --min_len 60` Want ~120 golden candidates, lock 30 as holdout.

labelops-bot: Queue created: `gold-q4b-170600` (120 items). Assignee: Vik. Holdout reserved: 30.

Vik: I'll run simhash dedupe (thr 0.83) + token-span >0.5. Also will run embed-recall with e5-small thr 0.68 to map neighbors.

Sam: Add fields for golden: prompt, actions, multi_step, implicit_deadline, deid_tag, failure_notes. Also please include provenance.sha256.

Omar: Can we add up to 40 synthetic paraphrases for nested-step failures, tag as `synth:paraphrase-v1` and never include synth in locked holdout?

Vik: Agreed on synth guardrails. I'll post dedupe counts + neighbor map here in ~2h.

Leah: Plan recap: 1) Vik dedupes 320->~120, 2) embed neighbor map via e5-small, 3) Vik hands queue to labelops, 4) synth held for review. Ping when dedupe done. Thanks.
